Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: In step 11, the Planner incorrectly interpreted the nationality information. After receiving correct data from Britannica (British) and Wikipedia (English), the Planner erroneously concluded that David Lean's nationality was "Scottish" based on the film's subject matter (Madeleine Smith was from Glasgow). This is a logical error; being English does not imply being Scottish, and the nationality of the director is not determined by the nationality of the historical figures in the film. The Planner failed to synthesize the correct information (British/English) and instead invented an incorrect nationality (Scottish) unrelated to the director's actual birthplace (Croydon, Surrey, England).
